title: [Grab And Move] Add haptic feedback when a window grab activates

status.label: Owned haptics implementation tracker
status.detail: The assigned Grab And Move tracker is scoped under #48761 and depends on shared behavior from #50162.

next_action.label: Post semantic-trigger note
next_action.reason: The tracker should remain limited to one pulse after successful window acquisition.

actions.label: Post Grab And Move haptics note

comment.body: This assigned tracker is the Grab And Move portion of #48761 and should consume the shared haptics contract from #50162. Please keep the trigger semantic: emit one Hover pulse only after a window is successfully acquired, never from the modifier or pointer-button press alone, and do not repeat while the same grab remains active.

judgment.rationale: The issue is an assigned implementation tracker with explicit parent and shared-infrastructure dependencies.
evidence: The issue is authored and assigned to niels9001.
The body names open parent issue #48761 and shared haptics tracker #50162.
Acceptance criteria define exactly one Hover pulse after successful acquisition and none for failed attempts or continued dragging.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a coordination note preserving the successful-acquisition trigger and shared-infrastructure dependency.
